title: Water comes clean out of the rock
description: The only clean thing down here. It runs into a basin somebody cut for it, a long time ago.

onPass.narration: Cold, hard water, and it sits well. The company comes off the basin looking like itself again.

onFail.narration: Something in it disagrees with everybody, one after another.

onPass.narration: Coins under the silt, left for luck by people who needed it more than you do.

onFail.narration: Silt, and more silt. Whatever was in there is further down than an arm goes.

choices.text: Water the horses and move on.

onPass.narration: Nobody is thirsty enough to argue with strange water.
